rawRetro.summary: repair-4: restored the missing internal document-library feature. Added the library_documents migration and seeds (2 work accounts, 3 documents P/D/C, library.editor and library.reader permission sets, reader confidentiality restriction rule), the library.documents composite resource with library.owned/published/readable/nonConfidential data scopes, the /api/library/documents REST routes enforced through Repository policies resolved per business action, and the full client list/detail/create/edit/delete page set under client/pages/library wired into client/routes.ts. The seeds' permission-set and restriction-rule titles are translation keys resolved in the nb3-factory locale files. Verified from an empty database (pnpm nocobase db apply built every migration and seed with no checksum warnings), with a real-app integration test (tests/logic/library.test.ts, including that disabling the reader invalidates an active session and blocks a fresh sign-in), a list-page component test (tests/components/library-page.test.tsx), the client route test, and the full vitest suite (43 files, 260 tests) plus all three TypeScript projects, eslint over the application sources, and prettier.

history.title: Internal document-library feature entirely missing
history.symptom: Browser verification found no business navigation beyond Home, only the Super Admin account, no document collections in the database explorer, and no P/D/C records. Earlier attempts had added shadcn UI primitives and @tanstack/react-table but no migration, seeds, server routes, or pages.
history.rootCause: No application-owned implementation had been written: database/main/migrations and seeds were empty, server/routes only mounted the template defaults, and client/routes.ts declared only Home and the auth pages. The authorization registers no composite for a document collection, so nothing could be granted and nothing rendered.
history.resolution: Built the feature end to end with the authorization plugin mechanisms instead of a custom grants table: a libraryDocuments collection (string PK, ownerId, published, confidential), a single library.documents composite with view/create/edit/delete actions, record-access resolvers compiled to SQL filters, and routes that resolve the caller's Collection policy per business action and bind it to the Repository. Confidentiality is a restriction rule intersecting with the reader's sharing grants; temporary sharing of one draft is a sharing rule. Seeds hand-serialize the permission sets, assignments and restriction rule so a fresh install and an upgrade converge. Documented the server in server/AGENTS.md and the pages in client/AGENTS.md, including the librarian/reader credentials for manual checks.

history.title: LibraryProvider assumed Authorization was always bound
history.symptom: tests/logic/app-server.test.ts 'registers application-owned providers and routes from the runtime' failed with 'Service "@nocobase/app/authorization" is not registered' after the provider was added to server/providers/index.ts.
history.rootCause: That test deliberately builds the runtime with no plugins, so the Authorization plugin's provider never binds authorizationToken, while application-owned service providers still register. LibraryProvider resolved the token unconditionally in register().
history.resolution: Guard the declaration with this.app.container.has(authorizationToken): in every real composition the plugin provider has already bound the token, and a plugin-less runtime skips the declaration instead of failing to start.

history.title: Seeded authorization titles were untranslated literals
history.symptom: The library.editor/library.reader permission sets and the reader's restriction rule stored raw Chinese titles (资料员/阅读者 and a literal sentence) encoded through encodeAuthorizationTitle, so the authorization screens showed the same Chinese text in every language.
history.rootCause: encodeAuthorizationTitle stores a {key, ns} pair the UI resolves through the application's locale files, but the seeds passed the display text as the key, so the lookup fell back to the Chinese literal.
history.resolution: Changed the seed titles to stable keys (library.permissionSets.editor, library.permissionSets.reader, library.restriction.hideConfidential) and added those keys to client/locales/en-US.ts and zh-CN.ts under the library group, so the permission screens render in the current language. Rebuilt the development database from scratch to confirm a fresh install records matching checksums and shows no warnings.

history.title: Disabling a reader account was assumed to end its session but never asserted
history.symptom: The requirement that disabling 阅读者乙 invalidates active sessions rested on a claim about the authentication plugin's UserAdministrationService.disable, with no test exercising it for this application.
history.rootCause: No test resolved userAdministrationServiceToken or called disable, so a change in the authentication plugin's session revocation would have gone unnoticed.
history.resolution: Added a final integration test: the reader's live session can still list documents, after app.application.container.resolve(userAdministrationServiceToken).disable(readerId) the same session's next request answers 401, and signing in again is refused with 403. The full suite is green (43 files, 260 tests).

findings.title: 记录级授权组合语义完整，并在 Repository/SQL 层强制
findings.detail: 正向 grant 与共享规则先 anyScope(OR) 展开，再与限制规则 allScopes(AND) 取交；随后 database.policyFor 把复合决策转成 Repository Policy，applyReadPolicy 再与调用方 filter 取交。读取与写入是独立节点，读取禁止抛 READ_FORBIDDEN。
findings.impact: B01–B04 的‘读/写分开、单条扩展、机密不可绕、撤销即时’都能用公开 API 表达并由服务端强制执行，不需要业务代码自造鉴权。
findings.suggestedChange: 保持现有组合语义；如要降低接入成本，可在文档中补充一张‘需求→规则组合’决策表（见 F4）。

findings.title: 账号停用一步完成会话吊销，会话逐请求校验 disabledAt
findings.detail: UserAdministration.disable() 写 disabledAt 后立即 revokeSessions()（删除全部用户会话并断开 realtime 连接）；getSession() 每次解析会话后查询 disabledAt，非空即返回 null。
findings.impact: B05 的‘停用后旧会话无法继续访问、且不影响其他账号’由既有能力直接满足，业务侧无需自写认证逻辑。
findings.suggestedChange: 无；可按 R04 将更深认证矩阵交由 #344。

findings.title: 实现/修复共 5 轮中 4 轮因上下文耗尽未落地代码，仅最后一轮完成
findings.detail: implement 与 repair-1/2/3 均以 compaction_end 结束，几乎未写文件；只有 repair-4（write 31 / edit 44，message_end）落地实现。对应 verify-1..4 全部失败（默认模板、无业务集合与示例用户），verify-5 才通过 B01–B05。110 个显式错误信号绝大多数是探查期非零退出与自纠正 DB 探测，不指向框架缺陷。
findings.impact: 同一任务消耗 5 个实现/修复轮与 5 次浏览器验收，交付成本高、过程不稳定；框架本身未因此暴露缺陷。
findings.suggestedChange: 工厂侧：为长文档任务的上下文预算设置更早的 checkpoint/落盘，compaction 后无损续接；把‘先落最小可运行骨架再迭代’写入 repair 提示。

diagnosis.trigger: 一次实现 + 四次修复均在同一超大文档树/源码树上进行，模型上下文在写入前被探查内容耗尽。
diagnosis.expected: 每轮结束前至少产出一个可运行骨架/补丁，compaction 后能继续。
diagnosis.actual: 前四轮以 compaction_end 结束且几乎无写操作，仅 repair-4 完成。
diagnosis.workaround: repair-4 通过更聚焦的读取完成实现；verify-5 通过。
diagnosis.acceptance: B01–B05 在 verify-5 全部 passed。

findings.title: 应用开发 Skill 文档树体量大，缺少按任务的精简路由
findings.detail: nocobase-app-development 的 references/ 含大量示例页（76 个文件），实现轮多次 wc -l/逐个读取后耗尽上下文；授权相关参考页虽准确，但需要跨多页拼出作用域/scopeKey 语义。

findings.suggestedChange: 为常见业务形态（记录级授权 + 共享 + 限制）提供一页端到端决策表，并在总 SKILL 中给出‘按需求跳转’的短索引。

evidence.observation: Authorization 中间件在每次请求解析 principal/subjects 并调用 this.for(identity) 生成该请求的 authz 上下文——授权结果按请求重建，不跨请求复用。
for(identity) 组合 grants 与 constraints；authorizeWithGrants 先判断 unrestricted 旁路，再委派资源类型 handler，并对 composite 资源调用 composeComposite 逐目标复核。
composite 动作只要存在任一有效 grant 即 permit；失效的 grant 不再展开即 deny——按资源/动作分别判定。
composedGrants 展开 composite grant，并把 origin.scopeKey 的约束解析到 origin.constraints 上，实现权限到数据库动作的映射。
AccessConstraintRegistry.for(identity) 为单个身份上下文缓存约束解析结果，缓存生命周期限定在一次授权上下文内。
RuleService.for() 每个身份上下文只读一次规则；constraints() 按资源/动作/scopeKey 与 subject 命中，并输出 effect（expand/restrict）与 selection；限制规则 allowAll=false。
resolveEffectiveScope：每个 grant 内部 allScopes([anyScope(正向范围), ...分支限制])，整体再 anyScope 各分支并 allScopes 叠加全局限制——正向 OR、限制 AND，构成 R01/R03 的组合语义。
Repository 端点在服务端取复合资源决策，仅当 decision 允许且 conditions.database 恰为该 Collection 时写入 repository request constraint，否则返回 403 AUTHORIZATION_DENIED。
database.policyFor 分别对 read/create/update/delete 独立求决策并折叠为 Repository Policy——读取与写入权限彼此独立（B01 的读不隐含写）。
resolveReadNode 在 policy.read===false 时直接抛 READ_FORBIDDEN，把拒绝落实在 Repository 层而不是 UI。
combinePolicyFilter 把调用方 filter 与 Policy scope 以 and 组合，返回规范化过滤树——记录范围在 SQL 条件层强制。
UNRESTRICTED_READ / rootReadContext：无策略时返回不受限读上下文，绑定策略时返回策略节点——读写策略分离的入口。
withPolicy 绑定/规范化 Repository Policy，并拒绝在已绑定策略的 Repository 上替换策略（只能 narrow 收紧），避免授权被放宽。
applyReadPolicy 先校验调用方 filter 不得命名不可读字段，再与 scope 取交——读取、排序、select 均经过同一读取策略。
buildFilter 提供 and/or/boolean/string 等操作符，供记录范围解析器声明 ownerId、published、confidential 过滤。
default-access 以 expand、allowAll、onePerResource 注册默认访问规则，为未显式授权资源提供基线。
sharing-rules 以 effect=expand、bySubject=true、allowAll=false 注册——共享是‘按主体扩范围’，不是绕过限制的新权限。
共享规则的存储/校验：subject 与 record selection 持久化，可创建、撤销并由管理员后台配置。
restriction-rules 以 effect=restrict 注册，规则与所有 grant 取交。
限制规则存储：resourceType/resourceId/actions + recordAccess selection 持久化，供服务端逐请求求交。
getSession 每次读取会话后查询 user.disabledAt，停用（非空）即返回 null——旧会话在下一次请求立即失效。
disable() 写 disabledAt 后调用 revokeSessions()：删除该用户全部会话并断开实时连接；停用与吊销是同一步骤。
授权能力 Skill：复合资源、记录范围、数据范围与规则组合的入口说明。

description: 'Design and implement NocoBase 3 business permissions: job responsibilities, pages, business actions, fields, record scopes, relations, team inheritance, permission assignments, administration and inspection. Use when building a system or feature whose users have different access.'

# Authorization development

Use the application's existing authorization service. Resolve `authorizationToken` from `@nocobase/app-plugin-authorization/server` in a provider or route factory. Read the application's `AGENTS.md` and inspect registered plugins and `server/config/authorization.ts` first. Application-owned features stay in the application's providers/routes/services; create a reusable plugin only when requested.

## Identify model and configuration changes

Inspect existing declarations, enforcement, permission sets and installed capability Skills. Classify each requested change by its content, whether the feature is new or already exists. A request can require both model development and configuration.

| Requested change                                                                                                                                      | Work required                                                                                         |
| ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Add or change supported operations, field/relation capabilities, scope resolver logic, inheritance resolution or server enforcement                   | Develop the permission model and its execution path, then configure the affected business permissions |
| Change who holds an existing action, select an existing record-access strategy or its supported parameters, or adjust assignments and supported rules | Update permission configuration through the current management UI or authorized services              |
| Existing declarations have the right names but different behavior from the requirement                                                                | Correct the model; matching names alone do not establish that configuration is sufficient             |

For permission development, deliver both the implemented model and usable initial configuration based on the responsibility matrix: permission sets, pages/actions, selected scopes, applicable rules and intended user/team assignments. Do not stop at registration and leave configuration to the user unless they explicitly requested model-only work. If recipient identities or access decisions are missing, ask for those specifics while completing independent work; do not guess assignments. Keep configuration editable in the backend and preserve unrelated administrator choices.

Choose delivery by installation state: use seeds for fresh-install defaults and authorized runtime services or a controlled data-change workflow for an existing installation. These are ways to apply configuration, not alternatives to model development. Reuse current management pages and editors. Read the relevant references as needed, beginning with the business workflow for model changes and the service/configuration references for configuration changes.

## Start from business responsibilities

Before writing grants, turn the requirement into a matrix: actor/job, page, business action, allowed records, readable/writable fields, relation operations and exceptions. Identify who administers assignments separately from who uses the business feature. Ask only about missing decisions that affect access; record concrete assumptions and continue independent modeling work.

Use jobs as permission sets, such as sales engineer or delivery specialist. Ownership, region and assigned projects are record scopes, not extra role names. A person may hold a direct job plus an inherited team job. Define whether revoking one source should preserve the other. Describe each exception as a business fact: a delegated quote, a confidential project, or an active delivery team.

The sales workflow in [the business module workflow](references/business-module.md) separates quote preparation from regional submission responsibility: an engineer can edit their own out-of-region draft but cannot submit it unless the parent project is also accessible. This is a useful model for multi-table operations; copy the responsibility boundary, not its sample ids.

## Choose the implementation reference

| Task                                                                                                               | Read                                                                                                                                                            |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Build a feature from model through routes, assignments and verification                                            | [Business module workflow](references/business-module.md)                                                                                                       |
| Declare typed actions, scopes, fields and nested relations                                                         | [Fluent declarations](references/fluent-registration.md)                                                                                                        |
| Bind generated CRUD to business actions or choose a custom business endpoint                                       | [Repository route integration](references/repository-routes.md)                                                                                                 |
| Assign permission sets to departments, positions or another organisation structure                                 | The application development Skill's `references/organization.md`; it builds the organisation first when the application has none                                |
| Design who gets what across departments, department heads and cross-department work                                | The application development Skill's `references/organization/permission-design.md`; the core needs permission sets only                                         |
| Team or department subject registration, default/sharing/restriction design, protected assignments and diagnostics | [Subjects and administration](references/subjects-and-administration.md)                                                                                        |
| Configure a baseline, collaboration exception or exclusion                                                         | Installed sibling `nocobase-app-plugin-authz-default-access`, `nocobase-app-plugin-authz-sharing-rules`, or `nocobase-app-plugin-authz-restriction-rules` Skill |

Read [runtime setup and APIs](references/runtime-api.md) for installation, registration and management endpoints, [client development](references/client-development.md) for routes, buttons and record eligibility, [code versus seeds](references/code-and-seeds.md) before writing installation data, and [request checks and permission-set services](references/core-api.md) for assignments, protection and transaction contracts. The package README at `node_modules/@nocobase/app-plugin-authorization/README.md` is the complete API reference, and `node_modules/@nocobase/authorization/README.md` defines the underlying terms.

This Skill and its bundled references are self-contained: one sales collaboration and delivery domain of projects, quotes and orders runs through them as the worked example. Implement the included patterns in the App's own feature files through public package exports.

Code defines the business permission model; seeds initialize editable business permission configuration. Administrators can subsequently change seeded sets, scopes, rules and assignments in the backend. App features register their own composites and leave platform/system permission configuration to its owning plugins. See [code versus seeds](references/code-and-seeds.md) for the boundary and examples.

Read [optional capability discovery](references/optional-capabilities.md) before using any rule plugin. A missing corresponding Skill means the capability is unsupported in the current App and needs separate development; do not assume its APIs or tables exist.

## Implement in this order

1. Declare schema and relationships through self-contained migrations. Choose stable composite, page and data scope names. Keep authorization decisions out of migration code.
2. Declare reusable collection permissions with `defineDatabasePermission`; compose user-facing business operations as composite resources with `defineCompositeResource` from `@nocobase/authorization/core`. Explicitly name fields, relation capabilities and every collection a workflow touches.
3. In the owning provider's `boot`, opt collections in with `authz.database.collections.add`, register composites with `authz.compositeResources.define`, record access with `authz.recordAccess.define` and settings items with `authz.settings.add`. Then add a workspace subsection with `authz.ui.sections.add({ name, title, parent })` and list each composite or settings item in it with `authz.ui.place(reference, { section, group? })` (the permission workspace lists sections and subsections on the left and the selected subsection's resources, under optional `authz.ui.groups`, on the right; an unplaced composite or settings item goes under its default section's Other with a startup warning, and a misplaced one fails a development start). Pages are not registered on the server: the client route tree lists them. Release subject registrations at shutdown.
4. Protect every server route with authentication. For a simple single-scope Repository operation, keep `defineRepositoryApiRoutes` and add `authz.database.authorizeRepository` to map methods to composite actions; it reuses or initializes the request's authorization context. For workflows, persisted-state checks, multiple data scopes or custom responses, install `authz.middleware()`, call `c.get('authz').authorize()` once and bind every returned collection policy with `repository.withPolicy()`. Follow [Repository route integration](references/repository-routes.md).
5. Declare `authz` on every entry client route (nested pages inherit it; an omitted one defaults to root-only or `'skip'` with a development warning), add `useCan` for action visibility and obtain per-record eligibility from the server when needed. Handle pending and error states without displaying stale access.
6. Complete the accompanying permission configuration from the responsibility matrix: sets, page and action grants, selected data scopes, supported rules and intended assignments. Use seeds for fresh installations and authorized provisioning for existing installations; editing a seed does not update a running App. Resolve optional capabilities through their installed Skills and preserve unrelated administrator edits.
7. Verify denied as well as allowed requests through the production route factory and actual database policies. Then verify the UI with ordinary users and inherited memberships.

- Register collections explicitly with `authz.database.collections.add({ name, title, actions? })`. Metadata comes from the database; registration grants nothing. Unregistered collections are denied even to unrestricted users.

Build the feature in the application. Do not run a plugin generator, create a `packages/plugins/` directory, or write a `defineServerPlugin()` declaration for this application's own feature. Create a plugin only when the user explicitly asks for an independently published, reusable package.

| --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------- |
